clips.title: The story
paras: Around Deathknell, Forsaken gather Scavenged Goods from equipment boxes. Newly risen undead rely on these discarded supplies to arm and clothe the recruits who follow.

New Forsaken rise in Deathknell's graveyard with little more than rotting burial shrouds. Nearby settlements and kingdoms offer the undead no aid, so they must salvage what they need. Deathguard Saltain gathers discarded weapons, tools, and garments from supply crates across the village, then gives them to the next recruits to rise.
